recognize_zh: 三顆形態正常的嗜中性球外緣都被一圈小小紫色血小板環繞貼附，形成像衛星圍繞的花環；血小板緊貼在白血球表面而不是散在背景，就是 EDTA 引起的血小板衛星現象，會造成血小板數假性偏低。
features: Three mature neutrophils each rimmed by a ring of adherent platelets (rosette formation)
Platelets of normal size and granularity arranged around the neutrophil membrane
Neutrophils otherwise normal with segmented nuclei and fine granules
Few free platelets in the background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several morphologically normal segmented neutrophils, each encircled by a rim of adherent normal-appearing platelets forming rosettes. Relatively few free platelets are seen in the background. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, an in vitro artifact that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; a platelet count on a citrate-anticoagulated or fingerstick sample is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without platelet rosetting around neutrophils or platelet clumps.
Platelet clumping forms free aggregates of platelets, often at the feathered edge, rather than rings around neutrophils.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm, whereas satellitism shows platelets attached to the cell surface.
Toxic granules are intracytoplasmic dark azurophilic granules, not discrete platelets arranged outside the cell border.
